entities.name: John
entities.description: One of the two speakers; a married father of at least three children including a son Kyle and a daughter Sara, living with his wife in the community he campaigns for. He hoped from December 2022 to get into local politics, focusing on education and infrastructure, ran for office more than once without success, graduated with a university degree in March 2023, blogged about policy, and ran projects for military veterans. He worked at a mechanical engineering company, was promoted to assistant manager in June 2023 and lost the job when the company collapsed in early August 2023, after which he pursued a hardware role at a tech company. He does kickboxing, taekwondo, beginner yoga and family boot camps, camps and hikes, kept a dog named Max for ten years until Max died in mid-2023, grew up in West County, and joined a fire-fighting brigade in July 2023 which he called his true calling. A close friend of Maria's.

entities.name: Maria
entities.description: One of the two speakers; a long-standing friend of John's with a small family she is close to, including her mother, an aunt who inspired her, and a cousin she helped rehouse in July 2023. She has volunteered at a homeless shelter since about mid-2022 — giving talks, organising meals, running a chili cook-off fundraiser and working the front desk — and was given a medal for it in August 2023. She also volunteers monthly at a local dog shelter, practises aerial yoga, joined a gym in June 2023, joined a nearby church on 5 May 2023, took creative writing and poetry classes, travelled solo to Spain in 2022 and to England some years earlier, and keeps two dogs, Coco and Shadow.

entities.description: John and his wife's son, one year old as of March 2023.

entities.name: Sara
entities.description: John's daughter; the family took a trip in 2022 for her birthday, photographed on a train track.

entities.name: Rob
entities.description: A colleague of John's who invited him to a beginner's yoga class in February 2023, the class John went on to attend at weekends.

entities.name: David
entities.description: A man Maria met at a charity event on 3 February 2023; his story of hardship humbled her, and she put him in touch with a nearby organisation offering housing and support for homeless people.

entities.name: Jean
entities.description: A woman Maria met while volunteering on 24 February 2023, who had been through a divorce, lost her job and become homeless yet stayed optimistic and grateful.

entities.name: Laura

entities.name: Cindy
entities.description: A resident of the homeless shelter where Maria volunteers, who wrote Maria a heartfelt note of gratitude that Maria shared with John on 3 August 2023.

entities.name: Samuel
entities.description: An elderly military veteran John met when he visited a veterans' hospital in July 2023; his stories were inspiring and heartbreaking and reminded John why he had wanted to join the military.

entities.name: Maria's aunt
entities.description: Maria's aunt, who believed in volunteering and helped Maria's family through money problems when Maria was younger; she is the reason Maria started volunteering.

entities.name: Maria's cousin
entities.description: A cousin of Maria's who had to leave her home in a hurry in mid-2023; Maria helped her look for a new place in July 2023 and John offered to find organisations that could help.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: John's family dog of ten years, who died shortly before 3 June 2023. John's best memory of him was a camping trip in the summer of 2022 where they hiked and swam; the family took comfort in a photo of Max in the backyard and said he taught them unconditional love and loyalty.

entities.name: Coco
entities.description: Maria's white puppy, acquired in late July 2023 about two weeks before 11 August 2023; she greets Maria at the door and gets on well with Maria's second dog, Shadow.

entities.name: Shadow
entities.description: Maria's black puppy, adopted from a shelter in the week before 13 August 2023; she was learning commands and house training in August 2023 and gets on well with Coco.

entities.name: West County
entities.description: The area John used to live in and calls home; he helped renovate a rundown community centre there in 2022, wanted to work on improving it as of May 2023, and it was hit by a serious flood in the week before 7 July 2023 that ruined many homes because the infrastructure was poor.

entities.name: England
entities.description: The country Maria visited some years before March 2023; its castles inspired the castle shadow box and castle painting she made for her home.

entities.name: London
entities.description: The city in England Maria visited; its architecture and history captivated her and she wanted to recreate some of that charm in her own space.

entities.name: Spain
entities.description: Where Maria took a transformative solo trip in 2022; she photographed a beach there, tried surfing for the first time, and learned to value solitude and her own inner strength.

entities.name: Oregon
entities.description: Where Maria's family went on a road trip when she was younger; its prettiest spot was a waterfall with a bridge she hiked to.

entities.name: the Pacific Northwest
entities.description: The coast John's family explored on their 2022 road trip, taking in several national parks; he called the nature breathtaking.

entities.name: California
entities.description: Where John's family took a vacation he remembered for a gorgeous sunset and an evening walk along the shore.

entities.name: Florida
entities.description: Where Maria's family took a vacation; she has a photo of the sunset there and remembers sitting with her family feeling grateful.

entities.name: the homeless shelter Maria volunteers at
entities.description: The homeless shelter Maria has volunteered at since about mid-2022, after seeing a family struggling on the streets. She donated her old car to it in December 2022, gave talks there, organised meals, ran a fundraiser with a chili cook-off in late May 2023, worked the front desk, and was given a medal in August 2023. Residents Laura and Cindy wrote the volunteers notes of gratitude, and Maria says the people there have become like family.

entities.name: the church Maria joined
entities.description: A nearby church Maria joined on 5 May 2023 to feel closer to a community and to her faith. Her friends from it went camping with her in June 2023, picnicked with her in July 2023, hiked with her, and did community work with her in August 2023.

entities.name: the gym Maria joined
entities.description: The gym Maria joined in the week before 16 June 2023, where she found the people and atmosphere welcoming and worked on strength and endurance; she had dinner with friends from it on 7 July 2023.

entities.name: the local dog shelter
entities.description: A local dog shelter Maria started volunteering at once a month around June 2023; she offered to help John find a rescue dog, and adopted her own puppy Shadow from a shelter in August 2023.

entities.name: John's service-focused online group
entities.description: A service-focused online group John joined in late December 2022 and still belonged to in August 2023, also described as a virtual support group. Members met in person to hand out food and supplies at a homeless shelter and to run a toy drive, and brainstormed projects giving underserved communities education, mentorship, job training and resume help. In August 2023 John asked his family and friends to join it and advocate for the military.

entities.name: the fire-fighting brigade John joined
entities.description: The fire-fighting brigade John joined shortly before 31 July 2023, inspired by Maria's shelter work. Its training was intense, its first call-out on 30 July 2023 saved a family from a burning building, and a two-hour donation drive collected canned food, toiletries and clothes and helped pay for a new fire truck. John called the team a family and the work his true calling.

entities.name: the mechanical engineering company John worked for
entities.description: The mechanical engineering company John worked at, where he was promoted to assistant manager shortly before 16 June 2023 and where he enjoyed an encouraging team. The company collapsed and John lost his job, which he reported on 5 August 2023.

entities.name: the tech company John applied to
entities.description: A tech company John identified in early August 2023, after losing his engineering job, as needing his mechanical skills for its hardware team; he described it as a possible job and a chance to learn.

entities.name: the local school John volunteers at
entities.description: A local school where John volunteered at a career fair over the weekend of 1 April 2023 — where he saw how a lack of resources limited the pupils' ambitions — and where he was volunteering as a mentor by August 2023; his students improved in confidence and skills and one proudly showed him an essay.

entities.name: the yoga studio John attends
entities.description: The yoga studio John goes to often, which he described on 22 July 2023 as having a chill atmosphere and great instructors and offering yoga, kickboxing and circuit training among other classes.

entities.name: kickboxing
entities.description: A martial art John took up by December 2022 and said gave him a lot of energy; it is also among the classes offered at the yoga studio he attends.

entities.name: taekwondo
entities.description: A martial art John practises; he left their conversation on 22 December 2022 to go and do it.

entities.name: aerial yoga
entities.description: The form of yoga Maria took up shortly before 17 December 2022 and still practised in June 2023; she uses it to switch off and focus on her body, and her favourite poses are the upside-down ones, which make her feel free and light.

entities.name: yoga
entities.description: The beginner yoga class John started at weekends with a colleague shortly before 7 April 2023, after Rob invited him in February 2023. It focuses on poses and breathing, helps him relax and stay flexible, and had become part of his daily routine by April 2023.

entities.name: volunteering
entities.description: The practice that runs through both speakers' lives: Maria at a homeless shelter since about mid-2022 and at a dog shelter from June 2023, John through a service group, a food drive, veterans' work, a fire brigade and school mentoring. They volunteered together in 2022.

entities.name: family boot camp workouts
entities.description: The boot camp workouts John started with his family in April 2023, three times a week, for bonding and fitness; the family gained energy, strength and endurance and his children became enthusiastic about staying active.

entities.name: camping
entities.description: John has camped many times and loves how uncomplicated it is, including a trip with his dog Max in the summer of 2022; Maria has camped a few times, most recently with friends from her church over the weekend of 10 June 2023.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: An outdoor activity both speakers do: Maria hikes with friends and with her church group, including to a waterfall in Oregon as a child and to a summit in July 2023; John hikes with his family and went on a hiking trip with workmates in May 2023.

entities.name: John's run for local office
entities.description: John's effort to enter local politics, stated first in December 2022 and centred on education reform and infrastructure development. It took in networking with community leaders, a community meeting in January 2023, a second run announced on 25 February 2023, a blog about policy from April 2023, and a further decision in the week before 6 May 2023 to run again despite earlier defeats.

entities.name: John's project to support military veterans
entities.description: John's project supporting military veterans, under way by 20 May 2023, built around a petition. It included a party on 19 May 2023 where veterans shared their stories, a march for veterans' rights in mid-2023, a visit to a veterans' hospital in July 2023 where he met Samuel, a call in August 2023 for his family and friends to advocate for the military, and a 5K charity run. Maria volunteered to help with it on 20 May 2023.

entities.name: John's community infrastructure project
entities.description: The community project on local infrastructure John proposed on 6 May 2023, prompted by a power cut and by potholed roads, and extended after a flood hit West County in July 2023; it also covers his push for better housing and affordable living conditions. Maria agreed to help win the neighbourhood's backing.

entities.name: John's community food drive
entities.description: The community food drive John started in early 2023 for people who had lost their jobs, prompted by unemployment in his neighbourhood; it drew an overwhelming response from the community and from volunteers, and Maria offered to help with networking and future events.

entities.name: the homeless shelter fundraiser
entities.description: The fundraiser Maria organised at the homeless shelter for late May 2023 to cover the basic needs of homeless people; it featured a chili cook-off and a ring-toss tournament, and John agreed to publicise it and find volunteers.

entities.name: John's 5K charity run for veterans
entities.description: The 5K charity run John organised in his neighbourhood over the weekend of 5 August 2023, raising funds for veterans and their families. Organising it meant finding sponsors, coordinating with the city and spreading the word, and finding sponsors was the hardest part.

entities.name: Maria's cross necklace
entities.description: A cross necklace Maria bought in about April 2023 to feel closer to her faith, which made her happy; a month later she joined a nearby church for the same reason.

entities.name: John's promotion trophy
entities.description: A golden trophy John keeps that commemorates his journey to his June 2023 promotion and the obstacles — technical problems, workplace problems and self-doubt — he overcame to get there.
